description: Source file implementing time zone functions using libc, part of Abseil's internal cctz library, handling platform-specific time zone calculations and conversions.

classes.name: TimeZoneLibC
classes.description: Implementation of time zone functions based on libc, supporting platform-specific time zone calculations.

methods.name: BreakTime
methods.description: Converts a time_point to its corresponding civil time and time zone info.

methods.name: MakeTime
methods.description: Converts civil seconds to time_t and offset, handling ambiguous or invalid times.

methods.name: NextTransition
methods.description: Indicates if there is a next transition (always false in this implementation).

methods.name: PrevTransition
methods.description: Indicates if there is a previous transition (always false in this implementation).

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns version info (unknown in this implementation).

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string describing the time zone ('localtime' or 'UTC').
